title: New Government Order Issued Regarding Minimum Wage
excerpt: The Ministry of Finance instructs federal ministries and divisions to ensure attached departments pay standard minimum wages.
body_html:
The Ministry of Finance has issued a directive instructing all federal ministries and divisions to guarantee that their attached departments, autonomous bodies, and corporations comply with minimum wage regulations.

Under the new government order, officials must ensure that no workers under their supervision are paid below the established minimum wage standard.
